channel.title: DIY Home Upgrades — new guides and checked listings
channel.description: A small product journal for DIY home upgrades: peel-and-stick surface tools and under-cabinet storage, checked against the live Amazon listing before publication.

item.title: Peel-and-stick wallpaper smoothing kit: what should you compare before you buy?
item.description: Four things that decide whether a kit earns its place in a drawer, checked against the Art3d kit linked from this site.

item.title: Under-cabinet paper towel holder: how do you check the fit before ordering?
item.description: Adhesive or screws, roll width, cabinet overhang and clearance. Measure these five things before you trust a photo.

item.title: How many tiers does your cabinet actually need?
item.description: A short measurement routine that stops you buying eight tiers for a cabinet that fits four, using the ORDORA 8-tier rack as the worked example.

item.title: What should you ask before any small under-cabinet upgrade?
item.description: The six questions that cover adhesive failure, rental damage, clearance and whether storage is even your real problem.
